nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Under Eye Bags Daytime Treatment

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe sensitive skin report the formula is fragrance-free or lightly scented and does not sting, burn, or bother the delicate eye area, though one unrelated reviewer reports burning and swelling.
segments.mature: Reviewers aged roughly 44 to 63 report visible plumping, softened fine lines, and a more rested look, with several making it a long-term staple.
segments.dry: Reviewers who mention dryness under the eyes or crepiness describe the cream as rich and hydrating and note it helps with tired, dry, slightly crepey skin without feeling greasy.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on fine lines, crow's feet, and crepiness generally report smoother, plumper-looking skin and reduced appearance of wrinkles; one reviewer instead reports the product tightened skin so much it created more visible wrinkle layers.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the cream feels hydrating, plumping, and non-drying even alongside retinoids or glycolic acid; a few others report dryness, peeling, or a dry white powdery film under the eyes.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports noticeably decreased redness alongside reduced puffiness after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the formula supports the skin barrier with ceramides and felt soothing after using retinoids and acids, with no irritation noted.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports using the product preventatively for dark spots rather than treating existing ones, so no concrete effect on spots is described.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer reports on acne or blemishes with this eye-area product.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer reports the product feeling oily; several explicitly note it is not oily or greasy despite being rich.

aspects.libelle: Difficult to remove from under eyes
Creamy lightweight texture that absorbs quickly
Good value, small amount lasts long

extraits.texte: I used Bye Bye Under Eye Bags three days this week. Yesterday the skin under my eyes felt very dry. This morning the tender skin under my eyes is peeling. Of course I don't want to pull on that loose skin, so it looks awful. I would say use caution. ( I have photos if there is any question from the manufacturers) Even one star is too generous.

extraits.titre: An Eye Cream That Actually Works!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] From the very first use, I was impressed. The texture is a rich, creamy balm that sinks into the skin almost instantly without any pilling. This makes it a perfect smooth base for concealer and makeup, which never sits cakey on top of it. After a few weeks of using it morning and night, the skin around my eyes feels plumper and more hydrated, and those fine lines are definitely less noticeable. The combination of hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and caffeine seems to soothe puffiness and has brightened my dark circles. I have sensitive skin, and the fact that it's fragrance-free and ophthalmologist-tested gives me peace of mind. This is the first eye cream I've ever used that I will repurchase without hesitation. It's a true multitasker that delivers on its promises.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love that this eye cream is very soothing and hydrating without being heavy. A little goes a long way and it absorbs perfectly for makeup application. It has a blue tint, which helps with circles under your eyes. The ingredients contain caffeine to reduce puffiness, niacinamide to even skin tone, hyaluronic acid for moisture, ceramides for a healthy skin barrier and ginseng. I've been using a lot of retinoids and glycolic acid on my skin lately, so this actually felt so amazing the second I put it on. I didn't realize how dehydrated my eye area was. I'm 50-years old and the delicate skin around my eyes immediately plumped up.

extraits.titre: Good reliable cream for dry tired eyes
extraits.texte: The IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Under Eye Cream is a solid choice if you struggle with dryness and slight crepiness under your eyes. Its texture is rich and hydrating, absorbing nicely without feeling greasy. It definitely gives a nice, noticeable plumping effect that helps diminish the look of fine lines instantly. While it won't erase dark circles entirely, it does a great job prepping the skin for concealer and keeping that area looking refreshed throughout the day. It's gentle, too—perfect for sensitive skin. A little goes a long way, so the jar lasts ages, making the price point more reasonable.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I honestly wasn't expecting much, but I honestly noticed a major difference after using this cream. In my before and after, I was fresh out of the shower faced in the before. In the after, I applied the cream, an IT Cosmetics CC+ sun protection tint (in fair) and cleaned up my eyebrows. I feel like I look much less tired and the puffiness and redness had noticeably decreased. I didn't have to cake on foundation or concealer. Just a tiny amount under each eye did the trick. It absorbed beautifully and didn't leave any greasy residue under my eyes. I am thoroughly impressed with these results!

I would highly recommend that anyone that suffers from bags under their eyes to not use this product. Not only does it not smooth, it does not get rid of your bags. it tightens up your skin so badly that you are left with several layers of wrinkles. it feels uncomfortable. I used it twice and threw it in the trash. Ulta refused to give me my money back even though they supposedly stand behind their product which they don't. I was sold a $6 product in place of this that works 10 times better. Avoid this product with all cost.
I'm 63 and it's amazing how much this helps my under eye area. I use it every day, and 1 tube lasts a long time.
